profile_text.body:
Micron Technology is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, trading under the ticker MU. Its own site describes it as a global leader in memory and storage, powering AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions. The company says its mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies that enable predictive and insightful experiences for end users.

The site's material is aimed largely at engineers and buyers. Micron offers data sheets that can be searched, filtered and downloaded, design tools and resources for testing, building and maintaining high-performance solutions, technical documentation, and an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples. It also points to a Technology Enablement Program (TEP) for enrollment and to sales support for contact.

Beyond the site, the company's profile records a CIK of 0000723125 and for-profit status. Its law exposure is in Idaho, with a count of 21. No products, lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it.
